findings.title: Write lock held across file and network I/O
findings.body: GetWebAssets acquires entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock() at line 48 and holds it (via defer Unlock) while doing readWebAssetsFromCDN (HTTP request) and readWebAssetsFromFile (disk I/O) at lines 56 and 60. Every concurrent caller, including the RLock fast-path readers, blocks for the full I/O latency. In Dev mode where the cache is bypassed on every call, this serializes all requests. The load should be done outside the lock with only publish under lock plus a second cache check.

findings.title: Missing second cache check after acquiring write lock
findings.body: The fast-path check at line 45 reads the cache under RLock, but after acquiring the write lock at line 48 the cache is never re-checked before doing I/O. Concurrent cache misses all proceed to read and parse assets-manifest.json (and potentially fetch CDN) redundantly instead of only the first miss loading and the rest reusing it.
